# Longbridge Terminal (changqiao)

> Experimental **terminal stock TUI** built on [Longport OpenAPI](https://open.longbridge.com): watchlists, live quotes, portfolio/holdings, search, and candlestick charts. Stack: Rust, Tokio, Ratatui, longport SDK. Binary/package name: `changqiao` (version in Cargo.toml, currently preview).

Chinese positioning: 长桥终端。命令行看盘与持仓的实验性 TUI + Longport SDK 参考工程；不是自动交易机器人。

## What it does

- Real-time watchlist and market data
- Asset overview and holdings
- Symbol search and quotes
- Candlestick (K-line) charts
- Multi-market: HK, US, CN A-shares
- Vim-style keybindings; i18n via `CHANGQIAO_LOCALE`

## What it does NOT do

- ❌ Automated order placement / trading bots
- ❌ HFT or institutional gateway features
- ❌ Investment advice

## Config (env)

Required: `LONGPORT_APP_KEY`, `LONGPORT_APP_SECRET`, `LONGPORT_ACCESS_TOKEN`  
Optional: `CHANGQIAO_LOCALE`, `CHANGQIAO_LOG`, `LONGPORT_REGION`, `LONGPORT_HTTP_URL`, `LONGPORT_QUOTE_WS_URL`  
Legacy aliases: `LONGBRIDGE_LOCALE`, `LONGBRIDGE_LOG`

## Quick start

```bash
cp .env.example .env   # fill Longport credentials
cargo build --release
./target/release/changqiao
# or: install script / packaged `changqiao` binary
```
